doNotInfer: This branch is cut from #1912's branch, NOT from main. #1912 deleted the old ground tokens and 17 var() references in globals.css now resolve to nothing. Fixing those is THIS issue's job and the reason the two must land together.
Do NOT edit packages/theme/run-surface-tokens.css. #1912 owns it and its content is settled. If a token you need is missing, report it rather than adding it here.

Do NOT use !important anywhere, and do NOT weaken the token layer to win the cascade. The correct shape is `.run-stepper__node:not(.juli-run-stepper-node--active)` or higher specificity at the consumer.
The computed-style test for the active node MUST be seen failing against the unmodified globals.css before the fix. Record that you saw it fail.
Status tokens used as TEXT switch to their -text variant; tokens used as BACKGROUND keep the base or -tint. Do not switch both.
The real shadow tokens are --juli-shadow-small and --juli-shadow-medium. --juli-shadow-sm/-md do not exist; #1912 found this.
--juli-run-muted-foreground was renamed by #1912. Use the new name; do not reintroduce the old one.
